name: Blinding Smite

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

summary: Right after a melee hit: an extra 3d8 Radiant and the target is Blinded until it succeeds on a Con save.
text: Bonus Action, cast right after you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike. The target takes an extra 3d8 Radiant damage from the attack and has the Blinded condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Blinded target makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success. Lasts 1 minute (no Concentration). Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the extra damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3.
